facts.text: A desolate world covered with ice and snow, located in the Anoat sector, a rarely-traveled portion of the Outer Rim Territories, it became famous as the one-time location of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Echo Base during the Galactic Civil War.

evidence.quote: A desolate world covered with ice and snow, located in the Anoat sector, a rarely-traveled portion of the Outer Rim Territories, it became famous as the one-time location of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Echo Base during the Galactic Civil War.

facts.text: The base was discovered by the Empire in 3 ABY, precipitating the Battle of Hoth, a major engagement during which the Rebels suffered heavy casualties and lost Echo Base.

evidence.quote: The base was discovered by the Empire in 3 ABY, precipitating the Battle of Hoth, a major engagement during which the Rebels suffered heavy casualties and lost Echo Base.

facts.text: Located on the fringe of the Ivax Nebula in the Anoat sector of the Greater Javin, Hoth orbited the blue-white star Hoth on a wide elliptical orbit.

evidence.quote: Located on the fringe of the Ivax Nebula in the Anoat sector of the Greater Javin, Hoth orbited the blue-white star Hoth on a wide elliptical orbit.

evidence.quote: Beyond Hoth was voluminous band of planetesimals, known as the Hoth asteroid field, from which small asteroids regularly broke off, crashing onto Hoth's surface as meteorites.

facts.text: The planet's surface was entirely covered by a frozen ocean, except where volcanic fissures opened up steam vents, depositing rock and minerals in darker patches on the glacier plains.

evidence.quote: The planet's surface was entirely covered by a frozen ocean, except where volcanic fissures opened up steam vents, depositing rock and minerals in darker patches on the glacier plains.

facts.text: A few mountain ranges pierced the permanent ice shelves, some being geologically active.

evidence.quote: A few mountain ranges pierced the permanent ice shelves, some being geologically active.

facts.text: The tidal pull of Hoth's three nameless moons caused fissures in the ice-layers, sending jets of ocean water into the freezing Hoth air.

evidence.quote: The tidal pull of Hoth's three nameless moons caused fissures in the ice-layers, sending jets of ocean water into the freezing Hoth air.

facts.text: The intense cold froze these jets into spires of ice, suspending primitive ocean algae within these tall columns and glaciers.

evidence.quote: The intense cold froze these jets into spires of ice, suspending primitive ocean algae within these tall columns and glaciers.

facts.text: Massive oceanic currents beneath the southern hemisphere caused regular seismic activity, resulting in a constantly shifting landscape of caves and tunnels.

evidence.quote: Massive oceanic currents beneath the southern hemisphere caused regular seismic activity, resulting in a constantly shifting landscape of caves and tunnels.
